title: Grouped or stacked
text: Vertical or horizontal bars, side by side or stacked, with negative values diverging from zero.

title: Keyboard bars
text: One tab stop; arrow keys move between bars with a tooltip on focus and hover.

title: Legend toggles
text: Legend buttons show and hide series.

title: Data table fallback
text: A generated summary and a data table, with a Total column when stacked.

title: Textures
text: Optional patterns so series never differ by color alone.
